title: Mr C Residences brand band
description: A 420px brick-red sign-off band covered in a faint line lattice, with a solid red panel in the middle holding a thin-line mark, a right-aligned light wordmark lockup (small name, large title, place) beside a hairline rule and a short stacked 'by' credit, and a tracked line of small print beneath. Still.
notes: a primary band with primary-foreground text; the lattice is a faint tint of that text colour
mark and pattern are slots (a logo image, another texture)
